intent: Check whether a Wurth anchor/wall plug variant in the 'Wurth Universal WU XLL-87U Anchor and Wall Plug' line with anchor_type 'concrete anchor' exists in the catalogue.

params.family_name: Wurth Universal WU XLL-87U Anchor and Wall Plug

success_criteria: Query returns whether a product_variant matching brand, family line, and anchor_type=concrete anchor exists
If found, answer references the exact matched product record_path

args.stdin: WITH match AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pf.product_family_name = :family_name AND pvp.property_key = :anchor_type_key AND lower(pvp.property_value_text) = lower(:anchor_type_value)) SELECT product_sku, record_path, product_name FROM match;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections

answer_template.message: {('<YES> The ' + match[0]['product_name'] + ' (concrete anchor) from the Wurth Universal WU XLL-87U Anchor and Wall Plug line is in the catalogue at ' + match[0]['record_path'] + '.') if match else '<NO> No Wurth Universal WU XLL-87U Anchor and Wall Plug with anchor type concrete anchor exists in the catalogue.'}
